must_not_run_until: The native-VAL eight-endpoint evaluation (runs/aircraft-native-val-activation-v1) has finished or been stopped by its owner and released the GPU; its guard halts on any other RyanLinEnv python process.

Root review approves this plan and writes an activated copy (activated true, activation.activated_at, activation.approved_by) committed before the first model call; the runner refuses anything else and requires that copy's SHA256 on every invocation.
scope: Named open-weight comparator on FGVC-Aircraft 2013b native VALIDATION only. No TEST image is opened, decoded or predicted. No training. No hosted calls, downloads or Docker.

baseline_identity.name: Qwen3.8-27B (mlx-community 8-bit affine, group 64), native instruct profile
baseline_identity.claim_label: Qwen3.8-27B-8bit native-instruct (direct answer), single seeded sample per image
baseline_identity.not_claimed: Not the strongest Qwen3.8 profile: native xhigh v1 was cancelled incomplete and xhigh v2 was never evaluated, so they are unmeasured, not defeated (runs/aircraft-local-baseline-plumbing-audit-v1/report.md). Not equivalent to unquantized author weights.

model.verification: run_local rehashes every snapshot file against the integrity record before each load; strict load, trust_remote_code false, offline
model.runtime_pins_source: runs/local-qwen8bit/aircraft-native-instruct-chunk1-usage-summary.json configuration.runtime_versions; run_local refuses mlx-vlm other than 0.6.8 and binds all nine versions into the run identity

generation.sampling_source: vision_rl.local_vlm.INSTRUCT_GENERATION (author-card native instruct values); identical to the measured chunk1 probe
generation.decoding_protocol: One seeded native-sampled completion per image (pass@1). The eight endpoints are greedy; this difference is disclosed, not equalised, because the baseline must use its supported native profile.
generation.output_budget_note: The native 16,384-token ceiling is kept. No reduced cap is imposed to cause truncation.

prompt_and_parser.same_as: vision_rl.vlm_local_evaluation (eight-endpoint native-VAL evaluator): prompt_text(spec, "answer_only") over the complete 100-label vocabulary, parse_label(response, labels, allow_reasoning=True) only for a normally terminated generation
prompt_and_parser.prompt_sha256_evidence: Equal to prompt_sha256 in runs/aircraft-native-val-activation-v1/bundle/plan.json and to runs/local-qwen8bit/aircraft-native-instruct-plan/prompt.txt (shasum -a 256, 2026-10-17); recomputed from data_spec by jq with the prompt_text formula.
prompt_and_parser.parser_source_sha256_evidence: sha256 of the parse_label source text in the evaluator frozen copy (runs/aircraft-native-val-activation-v1/frozen/src) and on main c966df4 (identical), equal to parser_source_sha256 in the native-instruct probe plan.
prompt_and_parser.terminated_rule: finish_reason == "stop"; otherwise the answer is None (invalid, counted wrong)
prompt_and_parser.no_repair: Raw generated text is retained; no answer repair, fuzzy matching or retry.

inputs.image_preprocessing: fgvc-aircraft-rgb-remove-bottom20-v1 (shared aircraft_data transform; original JPEG, RGB, bottom 20 rows removed, no box crop, no external resize, no EXIF transposition); run_local rehashes model-visible pixels before each image

sources_pinned_note: Both equal the native-instruct probe identity (runs/local-qwen8bit/aircraft-native-instruct-probe/run.json). The remaining runner sources are hashed into the ledger at a stage's first invocation and must not change afterwards.

discovery.selection: Within each of the 100 classes, the native-VAL ID with the lowest SHA256 of compact JSON ["fgvc-aircraft-2013b","fgvc-aircraft-freshpool-screened-grpo-v1","baseline-discovery",791,label,id] (salt pinned by decision D13); evaluated in author order. Metadata only; no image or model output consulted.
discovery.ids_evidence: Computed with jq -c and shasum -a 256 over audit/val-images.json by two independent jq reductions that agree; the runner recomputes it in Python and refuses on any difference.
discovery.report: numerator, denominator, exact IDs, macro (= micro by balance), invalid/unterminated answers, finish reasons, native tokens, generation and charged active seconds; a partial run reports completed counts and metric null

full.ids_evidence: sha256 of compact JSON list of all image_id values of audit/val-images.json in author order (jq -c, shasum -a 256).
full.regenerates_discovery_images: Yes: full VAL is its own run; discovery outputs are never copied into it.

gate.requires: discovery completed with zero unknown and zero hard-stop outcomes
gate.projection: 3333 x discovery mean image latency + ceil(3333 / chunk_images) x max(discovery mean load seconds, discovery charged seconds not spent generating / discovery invocations); a measured 0.0 load is used as measured; no recorded load stops the gate
gate.full_max_active_seconds: min(max_projected_active_seconds, active_cap_multiplier x projection); a hard ceiling (see budget_rules.refusals)
gate.ceiling_consistency: proceed only if projection + one full invocation wall cap (18060 s) <= full_max_active_seconds, because an invocation starts only when charged + its wall cap fits; otherwise a run costing exactly the projection would halt before its last chunk. With the 2x multiplier binding this also needs projection >= 18060 s
gate.discovery_identity: full VAL refuses unless every discovery ledger invocation recorded this activated plan's SHA256 and the same runner sources
gate.on_stop: Report the named comparator as incomplete. Do not change prompt, profile, output budget or sample to rescue it; any change is a new plan version.
gate.headroom: Not gated here. Whether the frontier comparison is still worth running is a root decision that needs the eight-endpoint results; this plan only reports the discovery interval.

budget_semantics.invocation_wall_seconds: load_allowance_seconds + chunk_images x image_seconds + long_generation_allowance_seconds (discovery 8700 s, full 18060 s); passed to the external supervisor as --wall-limit-seconds
budget_semantics.long_generation_allowance: 2100 s covers one 16,384-token generation at the slowest measured 8.2 tokens/s, so a long native answer is not truncated by the wall cap
budget_semantics.charging: A finished invocation is charged its measured elapsed seconds; a started invocation with no finish record is charged its full wall cap.
budget_semantics.survives_resume: The ledger's first start time and invocation count are never reset.
budget_semantics.refusals: A new invocation is refused when any of: invocations >= max_invocations, charged active seconds + the invocation wall cap > max_active_seconds (so the cap is a hard ceiling while the supervisor enforces the wall cap), calendar >= max_calendar_seconds, run output >= max_output_bytes, an unfinished prior invocation, or any unknown/hard-stop outcome (human review, no automatic continuation).

supervision.memory_limits_source: Same 36 GiB RSS and 36 GiB Metal active+cache limits as the measured native-instruct chunk1 supervision
supervision.one_invocation_at_a_time: run_local holds an exclusive lock on its run directory; no automatic retries

measured_cost.caveat: Two TRAIN images only; not a forecast. The full-stage cap is derived from the discovery measurement, not from these two images.
measured_cost.memory_risk: VAL contains images up to 13% larger (in pixels) than the largest measured one; a memory stop leaves an unknown outcome, which halts the stage for review.

analysis.metric: mean(diag(row_normalized_confusion)) via vision_rl.classification_comparison (the evaluator's scorer); micro accuracy supplemental; invalid, unterminated and missing answers stay in class denominators
analysis.comparisons_after_full: compare_classification(gold, baseline, endpoint) against each of the eight native-VAL endpoints from the completed evaluator bundle, paired bootstrap 20,000 draws, seed 2718; the runner's compare command takes the endpoint's canonical predictions as JSON
analysis.claim_limits: A full native-VAL baseline claim requires all 3,333 predictions with zero unknown. The discovery sample is a resource-sizing and validity diagnostic, never a benchmark score or a win. Frontier superiority still requires the frozen native TEST, which this plan does not touch.

deviations_from_strong_baseline: strong_baseline proposes comparing the placeholder-free v2 thinking request and a direct-answer request on the discovery sample. This plan runs the direct-answer (native instruct) request only, the one profile with a completed measurement. The v2/xhigh profile stays unmeasured and the claim label says so.
strong_baseline.identity asks for the owner's frozen plan values; they are copied from the native-instruct probe plan and runner (local_vlm.py hash, sampling, prefill, seed).
resume_and_journal: run_local attempts.jsonl: each image is reserved (fsynced) before generation; an interrupted reservation is unknown_after_interruption and never regenerated; completed answers, including invalid ones, are never repeated; a resume with any identity change (model files, prompt, pixels, seed, profile, runtime versions, sources) is refused before model load. The runner's ledger.jsonl carries the budget clock.
runner: scripts/aircraft_named_baseline.py (tests: tests/test_aircraft_named_baseline.py, fake backend, CPU only)
